calendarWriteUnavailable: Calendar writing is switched off in this build.
calendarPermissionDenied: MaybeSitter does not have access to your calendar, so nothing can be added. Your phone only asks once — you can turn it on in Settings.

calendarNoneWritable: No calendar on this phone can be written to.

widgetShowTitlesBody: Off by default. Anyone who picks up your phone can see the home screen, so the widget says “Private commitment” with the time and how much it matters. Turn this on to show the real titles on the home screen. The lock screen never shows them, and iOS hides them whenever the phone is locked.
widgetSaveFailed: Could not save that on this phone. Try again.

icsFeedsUnavailable: Calendar links are not available in this version.

aiImportStep2: Paste it into {assistant} and send it.
aiImportStep2Other: Paste it into your assistant and send it.
aiImportStep3: Copy its answer and come back here.
aiImportHandoffOpenFailed: We couldn't open {assistant}. Copy this and paste it there yourself.
aiImportPasteBody: Nothing is saved until you look at it.
aiImportPasteTooLong: That's longer than we can read. The first {n} characters will be used.
aiImportReview: Look at them one by one
aiImportReviewNothing: We didn't find anything to bring over.
aiImportTruncated: Compared against your {n} most recent notes.
aiImportConflictDefault: We'll keep both versions. You can delete either one later.
aiImportConsentNeeded: Turn on AI help first, and we can read a profile for you.
aiImportRateLimited: You've brought context over a few times today. Try again tomorrow.
aiImportPromptTemplate: Write a structured profile of what you reliably know about me: my goals, my routines, my recurring commitments, my work or study, my current projects, my preferences, my constraints, and the people my responsibilities involve. Leave out one-off events, anything you are unsure about, and anything about my health, faith, politics or money. Write it as short plain sentences, one per line.
